title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm used to minimize a function by iteratively moving towards the steepest descent direction. The learning rate is a crucial parameter in this process.

title: Role of Learning Rate
text: The learning rate determines the size of the steps taken towards the minimum. A small learning rate means the algorithm will take small steps, potentially taking longer to converge.

title: Impact of Learning Rate on Convergence
text: While the learning rate affects the speed of convergence, it can also impact whether the algorithm converges at all. A learning rate that is too large can cause the algorithm to overshoot the minimum, potentially leading to divergence.
